snippet.title: Roadster Race in 60 Seconds: Free Flying Car Game, No Ads
snippet.description:
A one-minute tour of Roadster Race, a free flying-car arcade racer that runs in your browser. Hold to fly, click again in mid-air for a barrel roll, boost when you dare, and don't run out of air.

Three modes: Race, Survival and Turbo. Play solo or with friends through an invite link (up to 4 players, AI drivers fill the empty seats). No download, no account needed, no ads.

On a computer: left-click (or Space) to fly, left-click again for a barrel roll, right-click (or Shift) to boost. On a phone: hold the right side of the screen to fly, tap it again for a barrel roll, hold the left side to boost.

▶ Play free: https://aristudios.fr/roadster-race/

Made by Ari Studios, an independent game studio in Lyon, France.

#flyingcar #browsergame #indiegame
